newsitem.title: USA: Metrowerks sees Q1 revs at $3.7-$4 mln.
newsitem.headline: Metrowerks sees Q1 revs at $3.7-$4 mln.

text.p: Metrowerks Inc said it expects revenues of $3.7 million to $4.0 million for the first quarter ending October 31, 1996.
In the year ago period, the company reported sales of $2.3 million.
Metrowerks expects capital spending in the first quarter to be approximately $800,000, up from $479,000 in the fourth quarter.
The increase is due primarily to the expansion of the Austin facility from 10,000 to 20,000 square feet and the opening of offices in California and Tokyo, Metrowerks said.

Research and development expenses are expected to increase in the first quarter, but at a lower rate than in the fourth quarter when the company reported $1.3 million in research and development costs.
SG&A expenses are expected to increase in the first quarter as the company continues to put in place the infrastructure for its expansion into the Windows software markets, Metrowerks said.
But this increase is expected to be at a lower rate than in the fourth quarter.
